summary.one_liner: Slidev is a Markdown-based presentation tool that builds developer-focused slides with Vue components, code highlighting, and live coding.
summary.what_it_does: Slidev turns a Markdown file into a presentation deck that runs in the browser. Slides can embed Vue components, and styling is done with on-demand UnoCSS utilities. Code blocks get built-in syntax highlighting with live coding support, and LaTeX math is rendered with KaTeX. Diagrams are written as text and rendered with Mermaid. The README also describes presenter mode (control from another window or a phone), drawing and annotation on slides, built-in recording with camera view, and export to PDF, PNG, or PPTX. Themes can be shared as npm packages, and an integrated editor or a VS Code extension is available.
use_cases: Build a technical talk from Markdown
Draw and annotate during a presentation
Record a presentation with camera view
Export slides to PDF or PPTX
notable: Markdown slides that can embed Vue components directly
Presenter mode usable from a second window or a phone
Exports to PDF, PNG, or PPTX
caveats: Online try-out is provided at sli.dev/new, with no install needed
